import numpy as np
from keras.src.quantizers import quantizers
from keras.src import ops

cases = [
    (8, False, [(-0.5, 0.5), (-0.6, 0.8), (-0.8, 1.1), (-1.0, 1.5)]),
    (8, True, [(-0.4, 0.6), (-0.7, 0.9), (-1.0, 1.3), (-1.3, 1.8)]),
    (7, False, [(-0.2, 0.4), (-0.4, 0.7), (-0.7, 1.2), (-1.1, 1.8)]),
    (6, False, [(-0.3, 0.3), (-0.5, 0.7), (-0.8, 1.1), (-1.2, 1.7)]),
    (6, True, [(-0.2, 0.5), (-0.5, 0.9), (-0.9, 1.4), (-1.5, 2.1)]),
    (5, False, [(-0.1, 0.2), (-0.2, 0.6), (-0.6, 1.0), (-1.0, 1.7)]),
    (5, True, [(-0.3, 0.4), (-0.6, 0.8), (-1.0, 1.3), (-1.4, 2.0)]),
    (4, False, [(-0.2, 0.3), (-0.4, 0.7), (-0.9, 1.2), (-1.5, 2.2)]),
    (8, False, [(-0.9, 0.1), (-1.1, 0.5), (-1.4, 0.9), (-1.8, 1.5)]),
    (8, True, [(-0.7, 0.2), (-0.9, 0.6), (-1.3, 1.1), (-1.9, 1.9)]),
    (7, True, [(-0.4, 0.3), (-0.8, 0.7), (-1.2, 1.2), (-1.7, 1.8)]),
    (6, False, [(-0.6, 0.2), (-0.9, 0.7), (-1.3, 1.3), (-2.0, 2.1)]),
]

all_ok = True
for idx, (num_bits, narrow_range, pairs) in enumerate(cases, start=1):
    diffs = []
    scales = []
    for mn, mx in pairs:
        diffs.append(float(np.float32(mx) - np.float32(mn)))
        _, _, scale, _ = quantizers.adjust_and_nudge(
            np.array(mn, dtype='float32'),
            np.array(mx, dtype='float32'),
            num_bits=num_bits,
            narrow_range=narrow_range,
        )
        scales.append(float(ops.convert_to_numpy(scale)))

    for i in range(1, len(diffs)):
        if diffs[i] > diffs[i-1] and not (scales[i] > scales[i-1]):
            all_ok = False
            print('counterexample', idx, i, diffs[i-1], diffs[i], scales[i-1], scales[i])

print('all_ok=', all_ok)
PY
